historical_priority_limitation: Historical novelty is provisional: the inspected literature did not state the four-vertex law, but exhaustive older multivariate graph-reliability priority is not established, and the full 2008 Ball-Neal paper was inaccessible.
integrity: The exact four-state outbreak-size law and all its consequences are proved by a 64-configuration connected-component table and algebraic factorization. The standard-library checker independently enumerates 512 underlying global/local opportunity states and passes 338 exact checks. All computational checks are supplemental to the displayed proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite four-vertex independent undirected bond model only, uniform single seed; does not cover correlated outgoing transmissions, variable infectious periods, other network orders or empirical outbreaks.
title: A universal one-quarter mixing reversal and a two-moment alias in four-site epidemic spread
